newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: HK cyclist wins Tour of the Philippines.
newsitem.headline: HK cyclist wins Tour of the Philippines.

text.p: Hong Kong cyclist Wong Kam Po held on to his overnight lead and captured the tour of the Philippines cycling championship on Sunday, the first foreigner to win the event in the tour's 42-year history.
The 24-year-old former Asian junior champion beat Filipino defending champion Victor Espiritu by one minute, 19 seconds to win the top individual prize of 500,000 pesos ($19,200).
Wong covered the 16-stage, 2,457.3-km (1,526-mile) race that started on the southern island of Mindanao and ended in Manila in 62 hours, six minutes, 28 seconds.
South Korea's Sung Hwang Ji won Sunday's 72-km (45-mile) final stage around a Manila park to power the Koreans to the team championship and the first prize of 500,000 pesos.

Wong trailed in second place behing Espiritu after 14 stages but, racing at a clip of 50 kph (31 mph), grabbed the yellow jersey on Saturday by winning the 15th stage from northern Nueva Ecija province to nearby Pampanga province.
Wong raised his hand in victory as he crossed the finish line on Sunday seconds behind lap winner Ji. Besides his cash prize, he also won a new car.
